title: Authority — Keep issuer revocation available at direction-history saturation
body:
## Approved implementation — 2026-10-12 KST

The user approved proceeding with the reviewed development priorities. This is the **next new product implementation**: fix the issuer-revocation blockage established by completed diagnosis #1439 and merged PR #1445. Deliver source correction, ordinary-path acceptance, compatibility/recovery coverage and final qualification in **one cohesive Draft PR**. Registration does not mean a local Codex worker has been dispatched or execution has begun.

Coordination: #1209; work entry: #1426; native product/authority and continuity: #1212/#1215. Keep #1439's five completed diagnostic criteria and all original failed/passing evidence intact. This issue owns the remedy, not another four-budget investigation.

## Outcome

An authorized issuer can revoke an existing grant through the ordinary supported human control even when the issuer project's ordinary direction history is full. After committed revocation, the same previously valid credential must be refused by subsequent protected operations, including changes to its already-authorized child project. The result must be durable, attributable, readable and recoverable without changing historical meaning or weakening other principals' boundaries.

This corrects withdrawal of an existing capability. It does not authorize additional agent capabilities, cancellation of completed external effects, automatic credential renewal, generic history expansion or a new authorization system.

## Source and evidence basis

Authenticated main observed for this commission: [`8df0ee1b98ca60790a8a3c931e7e3195ca36c197`](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/commit/8df0ee1b98ca60790a8a3c931e7e3195ca36c197), tree `e774f126cf109bd6c42b15a56af132276779eb3a`. Re-observe current main and competing work at execution; this is not a fixed checkout instruction.

- [Direction store](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/8df0ee1b98ca60790a8a3c931e7e3195ca36c197/lib/vnext/persistence/project-direction-store.ts): `appendDirectionRecord()` requires a transaction and counts every stored kind against 512. `readDirectionRecords()` independently performs complete bounded observation and rejects more than 512. `grantAvailable()` consults credential suspension and complete revocation history.
- [Human/agent operation owner](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/blob/8df0ee1b98ca60790a8a3c931e7e3195ca36c197/lib/vnext/runtime/project-direction.ts): `revoke_agent` uses the shared append; issuer/project checks and the full transaction remain its responsibility. Agent authentication evaluates the grant; mutation rechecks must remain at the operation boundary. The human owner reads the resulting state after commit, so a write-only exception that breaks readback is insufficient.
- [#1439](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/issues/1439) / [#1445](https://github.com/hynk-studio/augnes/pull/1445) record the disposable case: 511 issuer records (510 decisions and one grant), renewal requiring two records refused, a legitimate binding reached 512, and revocation then refused. After that refusal, the legitimate unexpired bearer changed its previously authorized child, sequence 1 to 2, with execution authority still false.

The experiment is reported owned synthetic evidence, not a production incident, arbitrary-project access, measured customer frequency or a new experiment run during this registration. #1445's qualification covers its diagnosis/verification correction, not this unimplemented remedy.

## Scope and mechanism ownership

Read current AGENTS, relevant 02/03/04, lifecycle/recovery contracts, #1439/#1445 and current source before choosing a mechanism. Codex owns the concrete implementation. Inventory record readers/writers, human and bearer routes, currentness/parent-child consumers, persisted projections, validators and backup/restore paths that consume revocation.

Choose the smallest bounded way to preserve withdrawal independently of ordinary history exhaustion. Do not preselect a new table, reserve size, version, generic control ledger or paging system. A narrow accounting/representation/read-contract change is allowed only when necessary to this outcome and explicitly justified. A necessary additive migration may be implemented and tested on disposable legacy stores under existing lifecycle owners; no production migration is authorized.

Preserve pre-existing record bytes, references, hashes, attribution, ordering and historical interpretation. Any compatibility boundary must be explicit; an old/incompatible reader must not silently miss a revocation or authorize a revoked grant. Do not silently reinterpret already-full historical stores as invalid, require destructive import, or rewrite old records to make space.

Maintain finite, complete and validated reads. No ignored tail, latest-N authority lookup, swallowed error, or fabricated no-revocation result. Do not solve this by raising all limits, allowing general append overflow, unbounded repeat-revocation records, deleting history, resetting a counter, waiting for expiry, renewing the credential, or changing project identity. Continued ordinary growth is not an acceptance target: decisions, grants, renewal, bindings and unrelated native/Web budgets must not gain a bypass through this correction. Explain the exact admission/accounting delta and its finite worst-case bound.

## Acceptance and preservation

- [ ] **Before/after ordinary-path reproduction.** On a valid disposable store, reproduce the existing 512-record issuer failure and a successful authorized child operation with an unexpired bearer. With the fix, invoke the normal authenticated human revoke route at the same boundary; obtain a truthful successful result and fresh readback, then prove the same bearer is denied on its next protected child operation. Do not substitute expiry, suspended fixture credentials or malformed history for revocation.
- [ ] **Durable complete observation.** After revocation, fresh reads and a fresh process see the attributed revocation, complete valid issuer history and correct current grant/child state. Original rows/IDs/hashes/lineage remain unchanged. Readback must not fail merely because the remedy admitted a control record. Historical observations retain their original time basis; current authorization uses trusted current state.
- [ ] **Scoped, bounded controls.** Cover legacy-full and near-full states, multiple independently outstanding grants, remaining authorized issuers/principals, and repeated/concurrent revoke requests. Revoking one grant does not spuriously disable unrelated valid grants or projects. Ordinary records cannot consume or bypass the control mechanism. Repeated calls do not create an unbounded append channel; define truthful duplicate/already-revoked behavior while preserving request/session replay safeguards.
- [ ] **Authority and race safety.** Wrong issuer, workspace/project, grant reference, authentication/session, stale/replayed input and malformed/failed required history remain refused without side effects. Preserve expiry, mutation/sequence limits, roots, parent/child attribution and execution-authority=false. Exercise revoke versus an authenticated child mutation with a controlled interleaving or real supported contention. Define the transaction ordering: operations committed before revocation are not erased, and a mutation admitted after revocation commits must not succeed using cached/prepared access.
- [ ] **Atomicity and response truth.** Inject failures at meaningful write and post-write/pre-commit boundaries; compare all relevant direction/credential/session/child/auxiliary state, not just a row count. No successful-looking revocation without durable effect and no partial state. Test response/readback failure or lost acknowledgement as applicable without pretending a committed operation was rolled back; a fresh authorized observation must resolve the actual outcome.
- [ ] **Compatibility and recovery.** Exercise existing pre-change records, including a legitimately full store. When format/schema changes, test supported nonempty upgrade, incompatible-reader refusal and fault-safe preparation. Fresh backup/restore preserves history and revocation meaning while keeping restored credentials suspended/without usable secrets under the existing recovery contract. Restoring a pre-revocation backup must not resurrect the old bearer. Unknown external-effect/reconciliation obligations stay unresolved. No real credentials are copied or changed.
- [ ] **Complete delivery and evidence.** Keep existing API/error/currentness contracts where possible and adjust affected ordinary UI/transport explanation only where necessary for this outcome. Update the relevant contract/usage/status owners in the same PR. Provide before/after evidence, caller impact, precise compatibility/bound changes, focused regressions, current planner-selected exact-candidate qualification, receipt validation, failures/NOT_RUN items and cleanup. Do not claim installed adoption or generalized scalability/usefulness.

Reuse meaningful existing fixtures and operation/recovery suites. Setup acceleration may use supported builders with provenance, but the claimed revoke and subsequent bearer refusal must exercise the actual authenticated operation owners and transport where material. No lowered constants, manufactured authority, direct production SQL or duplicated framework. Do not repeat #1439's independent packet/Web matrices without an affected dependency.

## Workspace, qualification and authority

Authorized anchor: `/Users/hynk/code/augnes`. Use a task-owned registered isolated Mac worktree under current admission policy. Preserve unrelated source, #1446's worktree/receipts/trial material, installed Companion and all production state. Resolve physical identity, origin, branch, HEAD, current integration base and clean/dirty state before work and deciding verification. Never reset/stash/discard/relocate unrelated work or remove another task's resources/locks.

Use bounded process/database/listener ownership and current focused test registration. Follow the actual Local Canonical planner for the final clean candidate; this is enforced authority behavior, not a docs-only task. Do not preselect a cheap plan, weaken checks/timeouts/owner maps or start a verification redesign. Qualify all selected phases on the admitted Mac, validate the receipt against the exact head/tree and freshly authenticated main, and retain original failures. No unchanged failed-head deciding retry, phase-stitching or reuse of #1445's receipt. A substantive new candidate needs its applicable evidence.

Authorized: source investigation, implementation and necessary bounded compatibility changes, synthetic disposable tests, applicable qualification, task-owned branch/worktree, commits/pushes and one Draft PR. Keep auto-merge disabled and this issue open for review. No merge, Ready, issue closure, installed adoption, production writes/migrations, real credential issuance/revocation/deletion, provider/model/paid experiments, live ChatGPT activation, deployment, GitHub Actions, fabricated statuses, repository-setting changes or scheduled monitoring. Task-owned synthetic credentials are permitted and must not appear in committed evidence.

## Approved sequence and other work

1. This is the next **new** product implementation; it does not take over existing #1446.
2. #1446 remains the existing independent route/test correction under #1433, currently Draft/HOLD at the observed head `4c01c5b6f325b0e2b7714400cd86b758a3e2857f`. Finish its own evidence-based correction under its current authorization; no duplicate PR, new live window or use/revocation/deletion of the retained trial key is implied here.
3. #1447 may prepare one task/asset/channel and public re-entry path independently where source/resource ownership permits. This is not external activation or an instruction to open multiple new infrastructure lanes.
4. #1443 remains the next principal product loop: execution-choice judgment, usable participation or direct/asset work, actual subsequent use, and continue/end-role decision. Its source design need not wait for unrelated controls; use of affected authority must consume the corrected path.

Priorities are not blanket logical dependencies or permission for shared mutable ownership. #1372 remains conditional hosted-file work and #1430 remains limited to demonstrated residual bottlenecks. Do not absorb these into this PR.

Update factual progress in this issue and canonical **Augnes** Space when authorized access exists; preserve design context, original diagnostics and implementation/qualification/adoption distinctions. Report unavailable live access honestly. Deliver the Draft with exact base/head/tree, worktree and cleanup state and a concrete completion or blocker report; do not stop at another plan or create tiny follow-up PRs for inseparable acceptance work.
